strongest_angle: Break down the federal prison sentencing of 35-year-old Brazilian national Ygor Fokin Saviolli, who received 12 years for supervising an international money laundering ring that laundered over $30 million.

key_facts.fact: Ygor Fokin Saviolli, a 35-year-old Brazilian national, was sentenced to 12 years in prison for his managerial role in a money laundering conspiracy.
The international money laundering organization supervised by Ygor Fokin Saviolli laundered over $30 million in illicit cash proceeds.
The United States Department of Justice Office of Public Affairs announced the sentencing of the Brazilian man for his managerial role in the conspiracy.

named_entities.name: United States Department of Justice Office of Public Affairs
